evidence.excerpt: recovering from corruption by rebuilding it empty ... "corrupt cache database; rebuilding it empty (cache content is regenerable)" ... remove_database_files(path)?

subject: Shared cache database corruption recovery
text: The shared cache database (opened via open_or_recover) is deliberately rebuilt empty when it fails to open as corrupt; content stored there is treated as regenerable cache state, not durable data.
